exhibits.quote: The standard Redemption policy for any product is thirty (30) days from the date of purchase unless stated otherwise.
exhibits.argument: The 30-day trial is limited because you must redeem/activate within 30 days or lose the deal, contradicting a risk-free evaluation period.

exhibits.quote: Please note that ebooks, encyclopaedias, whitepapers, and PDFs can only be refunded when the full PDF has not been downloaded yet.
exhibits.argument: The money-back guarantee is not unconditional as certain digital products cannot be refunded once downloaded.

exhibits.quote: We offer a hassle-free 30-day refund policy for products bought directly via earlybird.so.

exhibits.argument: This establishes the 30-day money-back guarantee for any reason, supporting the trial period claim.

trials.claim: MotionKit works with any WordPress page builder including Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks and more
trials.claimQuote: MotionKit is a visual GSAP animation platform for WordPress that lets you create, preview, publish, and reuse animations across different projects and any WordPress page builder, including Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks, Avada, Beaver Builder, Breakdance, and more.
trials.reasoning: The defense exhibit only describes MotionKit generally as a WordPress animation platform and does not name Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks, or other builders. The prosecution exhibits are generic liability disclaimers and do not show any builder is incompatible.

exhibits.quote: Vendors are the sellers and issuers of the Vendor Products and are solely responsible to you for the quality of the products provided.
exhibits.argument: Earlybird disclaims responsibility for MotionKit's compatibility, so the claim it works with any builder is not guaranteed by the seller.

exhibits.quote: Earlybird shall not be liable for any claim arising out of or relating to the Vendor Products, including but not limited to, any claims for false advertising, product defects, personal injury, death or property damages.
exhibits.argument: Earlybird explicitly denies liability for false advertising or defects, undermining the promise of universal page-builder compatibility.

exhibits.quote: MotionKit is a visual GSAP animation platform for WordPress that lets you create, preview, publish, and reuse animations…
exhibits.argument: This vendor description matches the claim that MotionKit works across WordPress page builders as a visual animation platform.

trials.claim: Users can open any WordPress page, choose from 100+ presets or create custom animation, preview and publish back
trials.claimQuote: Open any WordPress page in MotionKit, click the element you want to animate, choose from 100+ presets or create your own animation, preview it, and publish it back to your site.
trials.reasoning: No exhibit describes the open-a-page, preset/custom, preview, and publish workflow. The prosecution exhibits are only generic as-is and vendor-responsibility terms, which do not directly disprove that workflow.

exhibits.quote: THE SITE, ITS CONTENT AND ANY SERVICES OR PRODUCTS OBTAINED THROUGH THE SITE ARE PROVIDED ON AN “AS IS” AND “AS AVAILABLE” BASIS WITHOUT ANY WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EITHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED.
exhibits.argument: The workflow promise to open any page and publish back is offered without any warranty, so functionality is not guaranteed.

exhibits.quote: Vendors are the sellers and issuers of the Vendor Products and are solely responsible to you for the quality of the products provided.
exhibits.argument: Earlybird passes all quality responsibility to the vendor, so the claimed seamless open-preview-publish workflow is not backed by the marketplace.

exhibits.argument: The promise of 100+ presets or custom builds is provided as-is with no warranty that those presets exist or function.
